name: Hostile Bid
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach bad publicity, which no other deck gives — Hostile Takeover is the only card in the pool that does — and meat damage for Crash Space to prevent (Measured Response). Weyland Consortium: Building a Better World, an identity no sample deck uses. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3a: Let Them Dream for Offworld Office. Vantage Point Stage 4b: two Event Horizon for two Tithe. Stage 5a: Shackleton Grid for Regolith Mining License. Stage 7a: two Luana Campos for two PAD Campaign. Stage 7d: two Sacrifice Zone Expansion for two Off the Books, and two Myōshu for a Hedge Fund and a Measured Response. Stage 7f: two Tocsin for two Enigma, to be used from HQ for a barrier and a sentry. Stage 7g: two Flagship for two Wall of Static, for runs on HQ or R&D that are breached and not declared successful. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4a: two Logjam for two Palisade, two Business As Usual for two Petty Cash. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4b: two Hearts and Minds for a PAD Campaign and a Government Subsidy, and an Isaac Liberdade for a Whitespace. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5b: two Hammer for two Kessleroid. The Automata Initiative Stage 1: two Cybersand Harvester for two Hedge Fund, and two Pivot for two Measured Response. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Valentão for two Ballista. Parhelion Stage 2b: two Hostile Architecture for two Hearts and Minds, which Land Grab still carries. Parhelion Stage 7: two Superdeep Borehole for its two Business as Usual, loaded with six bad publicity when rezzed and a win when the last is taken. Parhelion Stage 8: two Anvil for two Hammer, a limit on breaking for a limit on breaking, and two ZATO City Grid for two Shackleton Grid, a region for a region. Midnight Sun Stage 1: two Maskirovka for two of its three Ice Wall, a barrier that ends the run for one that ends the run, and two Svyatogor Excavator for its two Luana Campos, an economy asset for an economy asset, which trashes a spent trap for credits. Tag, You're It keeps Ice Wall and Land Grab keeps Luana Campos. Midnight Sun Stage 4: two Azef Protocol for its two Let Them Dream, point for point. Midnight Sun Stage 5: two Stavka for its two Event Horizon, a destroyer sentry for a destroyer sentry, which trades another install for five strength as it is rezzed; Land Grab keeps Event Horizon. Midnight Sun Stage 8a: two Envelopment for its two Logjam, a barrier for a barrier, four ends of the run that fall away a turn at a time before it trashes itself; Land Grab keeps Logjam. Uprising Stage 1: two Colossus for its two Maskirovka, ice the deck's advancement can grow; Supply Chain keeps Maskirovka. Uprising Stage 4: two Cayambe Grid for its two Flagship, a region for an upgrade, two Wall to Wall for its two Cybersand Harvester, an asset for an asset, and two False Lead for two of its three Greenmail, a point for a point; Land Grab keeps Flagship and Greenmail, Supply Chain Cybersand Harvester. Uprising Stage 5: Transport Monopoly for its Orbital Superiority, point for point, an agenda whose counters keep a run from being declared successful. Downfall Stage 5: two Divested Trust for two False Lead, point for point, an agenda forfeited for 5[credit] and the agenda the Runner just stole back in HQ; Ground Control keeps False Lead. Tranche 8 Stage 5a: two Hortum for its two Anvil, an advanceable code gate that bars AI and searches R&D at three counters; Ground Control keeps Anvil. Tranche 8 Stage 7a: two Crisium Grid for its two Cayambe Grid, a region for a region, which keeps a run on its server from being declared successful; Ground Control keeps Cayambe Grid. Tranche 8 Stage 7b: two Punitive Counterstrike for its two Myōshu, an operation for an operation, a trace that does meat damage for the printed points stolen last turn; Land Grab and Ground Control keep Myōshu. Tranche 8 Stage 11a: two Shipment from Kaguya for its two Pivot, an operation for an operation; Supply Chain keeps Pivot.
